tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Chains Warden supports, with each chain’s native coin, dollar stable and gasless support.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find tokens by name, ticker or contract address across the supported chains. Tickers are not unique: many contracts call themselves USDC, USDT or ETH. Prefer rows with verifiedByWarden true (Warden reviewed the team, or it is a Warden token) or establishedAsset true (a well-known token at its genuin

tools.name: trending_tokens
tools.description: Tokens trending right now on a chain.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Candles for a token on its deepest pool, oldest first, priced in USD: time (unix seconds), open, high, low, close, volume. Also returns a summary: the change over the window, its high and low, and how far the last close sits below the high and above the low, to judge a pullback or a breakout before

tools.name: agent_permissions
tools.description: What this connected wallet has authorised agents to do, whether an unattended trading session is open, and the daily limits that apply.

tools.name: request_session
tools.description: Ask the wallet owner to turn on hands-free trading, so execute_swap works. Returns an approveUrl and a code: give both to the person and ask them to open the link and check the code matches. They approve with one tap in Warden; nothing changes until they do. Then poll session_request_status every fe

tools.name: session_request_status
tools.description: Whether the person has answered a request_session: pending, approved, denied or expired. Once approved, execute_swap works until the session ends.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Price a swap without committing to it. Read-only. Works for the native coin (use its address from list_chains), across EVM chains (buyChainId) and on Solana (base58 mints, case intact).

tools.name: prepare_swap
tools.description: Build a swap for the user to sign. Does not broadcast. Requires the "swap" permission. Native coin, cross-chain (buyChainId) and gasless (typed-data payloads instead of calldata) are all supported. Give the user reviewUrl: it opens the app with this exact trade filled in, ready to sign. If hands-fre

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Sign and broadcast a swap from the user’s wallet without asking them. Only works while the user has hands-free trading on (agent_permissions → handsFree), and within the same limits as prepare_swap; if it is off, tell the user how to turn it on (handsFree.tellUser). Spends real funds: check agent_pe

tools.name: swap_status
tools.description: Where a gasless (relayed) or cross-chain (bridged) trade stands, or a Solana swap (kind "solana", its signature) that execute_swap left unconfirmed. Poll every few seconds until done is true. Plain EVM same-chain swaps confirm on-chain and need no polling.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: The connected wallet, its X handle if linked, and everything it holds on every chain: the gas coin and each token, with the exact raw amount to use as sellAmount and a USD value where Warden can price it. A chain with no gas coin means: sell an ERC-20 with gasless=true where gaslessAvailable, or fun

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_tokens" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
